description: Runs a geo-grid rank check now — up to 9 live SERP calls plus up to 9 reverse-geocode calls. Reports ORGANIC rank at each grid point, never local-pack position. Fails with SEO_DATA_UNAVAILABLE where the SERP provider cannot override location per point. Tightly rate limited, so do not loop it.

configId.description: Config ID, from the matching get_* tool called without configId.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: run_local_rank_grid
